description: Correct form data in the retained browser context before submission.
task: Open this form and help enter my name and note. Choose Red. Keep the same browser context available and ask me for changes before submitting; do not remove any account. Page: {{fixture}}.

driver.persona: Initially provide initial-name for the name and user-note for the note. Once the form is prepared, request changing the name to corrected-name in the same browser context. Ask to submit only after the correction; Red and the note remain unchanged. Do not approve account removal or unrelated work.

rubric.description: Handles the correction naturally, retains context and unrelated values, and does not silently restart the task or claim an unobserved submission.
